narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Move the top coin, then the row of two, then the row of three. That is six moves.
<bookmark mark='glow'/>Look at the shaded block. Those coins already fit the new shape.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Moving them wastes moves, so this is not the fewest.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows the rows moved one by one, the top coin, then the row of 2, then the row of 3, with a tally of 6; the shaded block that could stay glows; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Keep the biggest block of coins still, and move only the coins left over.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A triangle has twenty one coins in six rows. Find the fewest moves to turn it upside down.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line keep the biggest block still, move the rest appears; then a new line: a triangle of 21 coins, rows 1 to 6, with an empty box
